# APOC Labs

> APOC Labs (apoc.in) is an AI hardware and systems company. It builds APOC C1, an agent computer that runs AI agents on a company's own infrastructure, and is researching the APOC Molecular Chip, a molecular compute-in-memory chip for energy-efficient local AI.

Official website: https://apoc.in
Contact: charan@apoc.in
Name: "APOC" is written in capitals. Also referred to as APOC, APOC AI or Apoc Labs.

## Products

- APOC C1 (early access): an agent computer combining local AI compute, an agent operating system and secure gateways so AI agents can run around the clock inside your own environment. Three configurations: Edge (AMD Ryzen AI 7 350, 32GB), Core (AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 64GB) and Pro (AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128GB).
- APOC Molecular Chip (in research): stores an AI model's weights in molecular memory cells and computes where they are stored, removing most data movement. Goal: a plug-in accelerator that runs large language models locally at a fraction of today's energy. The design is modelled and simulated; it is not a fabricated or purchasable chip.
